name: UA-G3-SK-Gate
title: G3 Gate Access Starter Kit
summary: Gate kit: Gate Hub + G3 Intercom + PoE++ adapter + 2-wire (coax) retrofit extenders for one gate.

special: kit: Gate Hub + G3 Intercom + PoE++ adapter + 2 retrofit extenders
requires: waterproof enclosure if hub mounted outdoors

extra.extender_note: retrofit extender: 10/100 HomePlug AV over coax, PoE+ out 0.6A

gotchas: Gate Hub is indoor-rated; outdoors it needs a waterproof junction box.
Retrofit extenders run 10/100 HomePlug over coax — ok for the intercom, not a high-speed link.
Touch Passes are free for only 10 users for 1 year, then paid.
Needs a console running UniFi Access; sold out.
